data.name: The Final Witness
data.detailed_description:
Every family hides secrets. Every victim has a story. Every clue can lie.

Investigate a haunted mansion in this first-person psychological horror detective game. Search for hidden evidence, solve interconnected mysteries, and identify the real killer before the darkness consumes your sanity. Every investigation unfolds differently, and every decision brings you closer to the truth... or further from it.

The Story

A once-prestigious family inherits an old mansion, hoping to restore it and build a better future. As financial struggles, buried secrets, and personal conflicts begin to tear them apart, tragedy strikes.

But the truth is never the same twice.

Each investigation presents a different version of the family's downfall. A different family member becomes the victim. A different suspect becomes the killer. Even the cause of death changes, creating a brand-new mystery every time.

When unexplained paranormal events prevent the local police from continuing their investigation, the case is handed over to a paranormal detective... You.

Now it's up to you to uncover the truth... before the mansion consumes your sanity.

Investigate the Truth

Explore every corner of the mansion, inspect objects, decode hidden messages, and connect scattered clues to reconstruct the crime.

Every piece of evidence matters, but not every clue tells the truth.

Your final accusation determines the fate of the investigation.

Every Investigation Is Different

No two investigations are exactly alike.

Each new investigation features:

  • A different victim.

  • A different killer.

  • A different cause of death.

  • Different clue locations and evidence.

Every investigation challenges you to adapt, observe carefully, and reach the correct conclusion.

Special Story Scenarios

As you solve investigations, you'll unlock handcrafted Special Scenarios.

Unlike the randomized investigations, these are handcrafted, fully scripted mysteries with fixed victims, killers, motives, clues, and outcomes.

Successfully solving a Special Scenario rewards you with the complete story behind the murder. Each one tells its own self-contained mystery.

Beware the Darkness

The mansion is never truly empty.

Supernatural forces lurk in the shadows, distorting reality and testing your sanity as you search for answers.

Perhaps the only one capable of helping you uncover the truth...

...is the spirit of the victim... The Final Witness to their own murder.

The victim's spirit may assist you during your investigation and guide you closer to the truth. But take too long, and they won't be the same anymore.

Every ghost behaves differently, with its own tactics, behaviors, and dangers. Learn what you're facing and adapt your strategy before it's too late.

More Than Just Investigations

Between investigations, you'll discover optional activities hidden throughout the mansion.

As you progress, you'll also unlock minigames, giving you new ways to enjoy the world of The Final Witness beyond solving crimes.

Features

  • Investigate replayable murder cases with randomized victims, killers, causes of death, puzzles and clues.

  • Unlock handcrafted Special Scenarios featuring unique mysteries and stories.

  • Explore a detailed haunted mansion in first-person, illuminated only by your flashlight. The electricity is gone, leaving you alone with the darkness.

  • Search, analyze, connect evidence and craft your own equipment to identify the true killer under the pressure of being watched.

  • Experience psychological horror with supernatural encounters and ghosts with different behaviors and tactics.

  • Make choices that influence the outcome of each investigation.

  • Discover optional activities throughout the mansion.

  • Unlock bonus minigames as you progress through the game.

  • Planned Early Access updates introducing new rooms, characters, investigations, and unique online modes.

Development Note

The Final Witness is currently in active development. Visuals, gameplay, features, and content shown on this page may change as development continues toward release.

data.short_description: The Final Witness is a first-person psychological horror detective game where every case tells a different story. Explore a haunted family mansion, uncover hidden truths, analyze conflicting evidence, and identify the true killer before the darkness consumes your sanity.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish, Traditional Chinese, Polish, Thai
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: System requirements are preliminary and may change during Early Access as optimization continues.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of murder investigations, corpses, realistic blood, psychological horror, frightening scenes, and themes involving death and crime. It does not contain sexual content or graphic gore.
